meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

howto.what: 装好后,当用户需要在 Azure Kubernetes Service(AKS)上搭建 AI Runway 时,Claude 会按序核对集群、安装控制器、检查 GPU、安装推理服务(如 KAITO)、部署并验证模型。
howto.when: 当用户提到“setup AI Runway”“install AI Runway”等安装或配置关键词,或要求在 AKS 上部署模型服务时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 AKS 上设置 AI Runway。
say.note: Claude 会从核对集群开始,按步骤安装配置。

say.text: 安装 AI Runway 控制器。
say.note: 会先检查现有集群,再部署控制器和 CRD。

howto.what_en: After setup, when the user wants to set up AI Runway on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Claude will guide through steps: verify cluster, install controller, check GPUs, install an inference provider (e.g., KAITO), then deploy and verify a model.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions "setup AI Runway", "install AI Runway", or similar setup keywords, or asks to deploy a model service on AKS.

say_en.text: Help me set up AI Runway on AKS.
say_en.note: Claude starts by verifying the cluster, then proceeds.
It checks the existing cluster first, then deploys controller and CRDs.

say_en.text: Deploy an LLM model on this AKS cluster.
